digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution and escalation ladder
propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries are hardcoded to bare Anthropic model IDs, causing non-Anthropic provider runs to resolve to direct Anthropic calls instead of provider-qualified models
Model escalation via models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic IDs even when the primary model is Bedrock-qualified, causing silent cross-provider escalation failures
Three separate batch runner call sites independently copy model_ladder[0] to cfg.model without class resolution, each introducing the same split-brain regression
MODEL_LADDER serves dual purposes (escalation order and context window budgeting) that would break if ladder rungs became class names instead of bare model IDs

Reserved class names (trivial, standard, frontier) must resolve through model_classes.resolve_model_string at runtime call sites rather than load-time, to respect process-scoped provider configuration
